steps.note: Gary and Imran at the workshop bench, defaults (no m02 protection): Gary's talk-round runs to the four-way close; Imran is sent home with his phone.

said: I asked you not to be the fifth person to treat him as an overhead.
They sacked IT after the inquiry and kept the board.
I took it. The rent doesn't care whose side you're on.
I've not shipped a thing. Call it a work-to-rule.
A man on their bench who ships nothing is worth something to us.
We told the board, in writing. Nobody read it.
Casualties. His own sums, in thousands.
Let him go and the phone goes with him.
Names, not stores. Look at the log.
I'm sending her home. Don't stop me.
notSaid: You weren't supposed to be here, Gary.
